evidence: Reproduction succeeded. In the local FastAPI harness that reuses codebase/deploy/docker/auth.py, a request without Authorization returned 200 with {"success": true, "dependency_value": null}, while an invalid bearer token returned 401 and a valid token returned 200. This matches the bug report and the code path at codebase/deploy/docker/auth.py:31-35 together with the protected route pattern in codebase/deploy/docker/server.py:431-435.
steps: Create a tiny FastAPI app that uses get_token_dependency({"security": {"jwt_enabled": True}}) exactly as the server does.
Send one request without an Authorization header, one with an invalid bearer token, and one with a valid token created by create_access_token().
Observe that the missing-token request is accepted with HTTP 200 instead of HTTP 401.
